name: Patrol point
description: A node of the squad patrol network. Node numbers run 1..N with no gaps. MSR 'Squad patrol network'.

fields.name: arg1
fields.description: the command's first argument (command 8: chance of not stopping)

fields.name: flags
fields.description: 0x02 sniper point; 0x04 sets squad flag 0x1000 while heading here

fields.name: startAtLoad
fields.description: keep 0 (every stock node): non-zero makes the nearest squadron ride the node's lift (behaviour 0x1F) from level load, which only ends at a node with a lift, so without one it stops at its first node and ignores its own behaviour (decomp MSR mod #6)
